extDescription.message: Syncs your Mercado Livre affiliate session with the dashboard to generate links automatically.

popup_connect_hint.message: Open the dashboard to connect the extension.

session_logged_out.message: Sign in to Mercado Livre in this browser

session_auto_hint.message: Renews automatically while the browser is open.

guard_needs_login.message: Sign in to the dashboard to continue.

guard_plan_required.message: Feature unavailable on your current plan.

err_session_expired.message: Session expired. Open the dashboard to reconnect.

err_plan_unavailable.message: Feature unavailable on your current plan.

err_consent_required.message: Accept the marketplace terms of use in the dashboard.

err_ml_not_logged.message: You are not signed in to Mercado Livre in this browser.

err_ml_account_mismatch.message: Mercado Livre account changed. Sync again.

err_ml_sync_failed.message: Failed to sync Mercado Livre session.

err_rate_limited.message: Syncing too frequently. Wait a few minutes.
